backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point for the ICP canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming implementation of the /images folder structure and image references across Home, About, and Services pages.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and any notable fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, primary, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with a root div and a module script tag pointing to main.tsx.
frontend/public/images/.gitkeep: Empty file used to track the frontend/public/images/ directory in git.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with a root layout (Header + Footer) and four routes: Home, About, Services, and Contact.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Four-column footer component with brand info, quick links, services list, contact details, social icons, and a dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky responsive header with the Brainscribe logo, desktop nav with active-state styling, a mobile hamburger menu, and a 'Get in Touch' CTA button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login, logout, and identity state across the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Poppins fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, and defines CSS custom properties for a corporate blue/white color palette along with reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack Query's QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page component displaying Brainscribe's company values, historical milestones from 2019–2025, and key differentiators using icon cards and a timeline layout.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page component showing company contact details (address, email, phone, hours), a contact form section, and an FAQ list for common client questions.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component featuring a hero section, a grid of six service cards, company stats, and a 'Why Us' section highlighting Brainscribe's expertise and approach.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Services page component that renders detailed alternating-layout sections for each of Brainscribe's six service offerings, including descriptions, highlight bullet points, and images.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens (navy, sky, slate, semantic UI colors, chart, sidebar), custom fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file describing the Brainscribe corporate website build: a 4-page static HTML5/CSS/JS site with blue/white theme, listing architectural notes, required images, and completed features for header, footer, home page, and other pages.
